reason: After the audit we went through, I'm not putting our maintenance and driver records into software from a brand-new company with no customers. Nothing in this says it was built for Australian accreditation or that it works with the GPS trackers we already pay for.
objection: Would these records actually stand up in an accreditation audit, or is it a generic booking tool with an Aussie price tag? And if the company folds in a year, what happens to my compliance history?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it map maintenance and driver records to accreditation requirements in my state, with export-ready audit reports, plus a couple of operators like us who've used it through an audit.
